minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  November 24, 2020

  The Joint Powers Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting
  on Tuesday, November 24, 2020 in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Joint
  Powers Authority at the hour of 2:03 p.m.
  The Acting City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary /Housing Authority Secretary /Joint
  Powers Authority Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts,
  Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing
  Authority Members/ Joint Powers Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Franklin; and
  Absent:  None.

  City/Successor Agency / Housing Authority/Joint Powers Authority officials and
  personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  Acting City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO
  Jacquelyn Gordon  Staff Assistant

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, and Joint Powers
  Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts inquired
  if there were any persons present who wished to address the City Council/Successor
  Agency/Housing Authority/Joint Powers Authority on any item on the Agendas, other
  than the Public Hearings.

  Caller (Name Unknown) spoke on Agenda Items Nos. 3, 6, 11, 12, and O-1.

  Gil Mathieu, District 4, spoke on Warrants and Bills.

  JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY MINUTES. It was moved by Joint Powers Authority
  Member Morales, and seconded by Joint Powers Authority Member Padilla that the
  Minutes for the Joint Powers Authority Meetings held on June 23, 2020, June 30, 2020,
  July 7, 2020, July 14, 2020, and July 21, 2020, be approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Joint Powers Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Franklin, and Joint
  Powers Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  There being no further business to be presented, Joint Powers Chairman Butts declared
  the meeting adjourned in memory of Mr. Williams, father of Toya Ferguson at the hour
  of 3:12 p.m.

  Approved this 15th day of June, 2021.
.
